description: This file defines functions to create and load different variants of the DETR object detection model, including specific configurations for ResNet50 and ResNet101 backbones with optional dilation and pretrained weights.

methods.name: _make_detr
methods.description: Constructs a DETR model with specified backbone, dilation, and number of classes.

methods.name: detr_resnet50
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with a ResNet-50 backbone, optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with a ResNet-50 backbone with dilation, optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet101
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with a ResNet-101 backbone, optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_dc5
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with a ResNet-101 backbone with dilation, optionally pretrained.
